title: A Spoil of Office: A Story of the Modern West

Through his experiences, readers are invited to engage with themes of ambition, class struggle, and the pursuit of a better life in a rapidly changing society. As Bradley drives the omnibus, the vibrant atmosphere contrasts sharply with his internal struggles of feeling marginalized and unnoticed. The early chapters lay the groundwork for Bradley's journey of self-discovery and ambition amidst the socio-political challenges faced by farmers of the time, illustrating his introspective nature and the allure of political life that beckons him to step beyond his role as a laborer.
